edit.description: Replace exact text in a file. Put the file path in `target`, and in `change` the text to find (`find`) and its replacement (`replace`). The text to find must occur exactly once.

target.description: Absolute path of the file to change

bash.description: Run a shell command in the repository. Always fill `purpose` with one short sentence saying why you run the command.

purpose.description: Why you run this command, in one short sentence

read.description: Read a file or a directory listing. PROFILE-PROBE: this is the configured read description.
